summary: Iteration 24 = fix-retest of iteration_23's 3 CRITICAL/HIGH missing owner gates. Minted owner (owner.qa@emergent.sh, role=owner) + reviewer (vishal.k@emergent.sh, role=member) Mongo sessions via iter23_setup.py. BACKEND (11/11 pytest passed, /app/backend/tests/test_iter24_owner_gates.py): all three gates now enforced — reviewer POST /api/projects/{pid}/documents => 403 'Owner access required'; reviewer DELETE /api/projects/{pid}/documents/{id} => 403 and the target doc (an owner-created throwaway) survived intact; reviewer PUT /api/projects/{pid}/config => 403; reviewer POST .../restore => 404/403. OWNER REGRESSION: owner create throwaway doc 200 + GET verified, owner PUT /config with the CURRENT navigation 200 with byte-identical navigation after, owner DELETE 200 and subsequent GET 404; doc count still 121, 0 published, no leftover test slugs. REVIEWER CONTENT EDIT (no regression): reviewer PUT on assigned doc put-your-app-live => 200 with reviewer_edited_by='vishal.k@emergent.sh' persisted; unassigned doc => 403 with content untouched; assignments scoped to exactly 18 slugs; reviewer 403 on /known-emails, /roles/owners, /roles/promote; owner /roles/owners 200 with sarang@emergent.sh and no _id leak. FRONTEND (Playwright, preview URL, cookie auth): OWNER on /admin/editor/{pid}/{docId} sees configurations-btn + version-history-btn + export-all-btn; REVIEWER on the same URL has all three HIDDEN (and no 'Unlinked Documents' section), can still open the editor and navigate sidebar pages (clicked 'Keep it safe' -> routed + content rendered). Role tabs: owner sees Overview/Assignments/Inbox/Publish/Team + 3 make-owner buttons on Team; reviewer sees ONLY review-tab-assignments. Reviewer /review/put-your-app-live still shows reviewpage-edit-btn + reviewpage-open-editor-btn. ALL DATA RESTORED via iter23_cleanup.py: 121 docs, 0 published, 0 reviewer_edited_by, 52 assignments, owner_invites=[sarang@emergent.sh], 0 qa_sess_ sessions, 0 qa users, navigation unchanged (no phantom 'New Tab').

ui_bugs.issue: Structural controls that still 403 server-side remain visible to reviewers: 'New Tab' and the per-page '...' menus. Clicking 'New Tab' as a reviewer optimistically adds the tab, gets 403 on PUT /config, then silently re-fetches and reverts — NO toast/error is shown to the user (Editor.jsx handleSaveNavConfig ~583 only console.errors and calls fetchProjectData). Not destructive (server rejects), but confusing. Recommend hiding New Tab / page ... actions for !isOwner and adding a toast.error on 403.

action_items: OPTIONAL/MEDIUM: hide 'New Tab' and per-page '...' (add/delete/reorder) controls in Editor.jsx for non-owner sessions, and surface a toast.error on the 403 in handleSaveNavConfig instead of a silent revert.

STILL OPEN from iteration_23 (unfixed, cosmetic): on every protected page load with a valid session cookie the first 2-3 /api/auth/me and /api/roles/me calls return 401 (console 'AxiosError', 'Failed to fetch project') before identical retries succeed. Reproduced again on both editor and review routes.
STILL OPEN (low): GET /projects/{pid}/documents returns all 121 docs to reviewers; the reviewer editor only needs the assigned subset.
critical_code_review_comments: require_owner() (server.py ~438) is now applied to create_document (~627), delete_document (~739) and update_project_config (~917) and is verified working; consider a dependency (Depends(get_owner_user)) instead of per-route calls so future mutating routes can't be added ungated.

Editor.jsx is 1459 lines — over the 700-line guideline; the isOwner gating is now scattered across 7 call sites (185/745/878/891/998/1009/1152). Extracting an <OwnerOnly> wrapper or splitting the sidebar out would reduce the risk of another missed gate.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/Editor.jsx (added data-testid="configurations-btn" and data-testid="version-history-btn" only — no logic change)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested gating + regression flows verified

rca_of_the_issue: Fix confirmed: require_owner(user) raising HTTPException(403, 'Owner access required') is now the first statement of create_document, delete_document and update_project_config, so a role='member' session is rejected before any project lookup or mutation — no document or navigation state is touched (verified: throwaway doc still retrievable after the reviewer DELETE probe, navigation JSON byte-identical after the reviewer config PUT probe). Residual gap is presentational only: the frontend still renders navigation-mutating affordances for reviewers and swallows the resulting 403.
